title: Cube Ninja
description: Slice through the obstacles and test your ninja skills in this arcade game.
about:
Cube Ninja is a browser game where you start a round and slice the moving targets while avoiding mistakes. Use the on-screen menu to replay.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Start a round and slice the moving targets while avoiding mistakes. Use the on-screen menu to replay.
tips: Use mouse / touch to aim and slice.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Cube Ninja?
faq.answer: Start a round and slice the moving targets while avoiding mistakes. Use the on-screen menu to replay.

faq.question: Can I play Cube Ninja in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
